The selection shall be limited to the configured local addresses (TcpIpAddrId) on the same EthIfCtrl as the bound local address (TcpIpAddrId) only.

If data is transmitted using an IPv6 socket which is bound to a local address (TcpIpAddrId) using the wildcard “ANY”, the TcpIp shall select the source IP address of the IPv6 header according to the source address selection algorith m spe cified in section 5 of IETF RFC 6724 (Default Address Selection for IPv6). The selection shall be limited to the configured local addresses (TcpIpAddrId) on the same EthIfCtrl as the bound local address (TcpIpAddrId) only.
